newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money rates stay high amid cash squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money rates stay high amid cash squeeze.

text.p: Pakistani money rates remained high on Monday in a tight market, dealers said.
"Bids and offers were both being quoted at 20 percent with no bargains," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Some borrowers had to cross the 20 percent mark and started bidding at 22 and 23 percent since they were unable to approach the State (central) Bank of Pakistan discount window, he said.
Market players were thought to have gone to the discount window for substantial amounts, he said.
